description_sq:
Apartament 1+1 per shitje ne Rrugen Qemal Stafa!
Apartamenti eshte i orgnizuar ne dhome ndenjie me ambient gatimi te vecuar, 1 dhome gjumi, koridori, tualeti dhe ballkoni.
Ndodhet ne katin e pare banim te nje pallati ekzistues prane rruges kryesore .
Apartamenti disponon certifikate pronesie.
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Qemal Stafa Street! The apartment is organized in a living room with a separate kitchen, 1 bedroom, corridor, toilet and balcony. It is located on the first residential floor of an existing building near the main road. The apartment has ownership certificates.
